lines.text: The inner court's east gate stays shut on the six work days but opens on Sabbaths and New Moons.
On the Sabbath the prince offers six unblemished lambs and a ram, and on the New Moon a bull too.
At the appointed feasts, a worshiper who enters by the north gate to worship must leave by the east gate.
Every morning an unblemished year-old goat is provided as a daily burnt offering to the LORD.
At the far western end of the priests' chambers, the priests boil the guilt and sin offerings and bake the grain offering.
